description: Phase 1 - Smart Suggestions: Add time-based contextual suggestion cards (Morning 05:00-09:59 and Night 20:00-02:00) that display above the existing home view content. Morning card shows wellness tips with Quick Routine/Full Routine/Customize buttons. Night card shows step-by-step pre-sleep cards with Start Yog Nidra/Customize buttons. Cards are dismissible and the existing Custom Flow (feeling selection) remains untouched below.
steps: Step 1: In the JavaScript section (around line 560 in the <script> tag), add a function getTimeOfDay() that returns 'morning' (05:00-09:59), 'night' (20:00-02:00), or 'other' based on current hour using new Date().getHours().

Step 2: Add a new HTML section inside view-home (div id='view-home'), placed AFTER the heading div (h1 'Mental Reset') but BEFORE the 'Gentle Smile Reminder Card'. This section will have id='smart-suggestion-container' and will be conditionally populated by JavaScript.
Step 3: Create a function renderSmartSuggestion() that checks getTimeOfDay() and renders the appropriate card into #smart-suggestion-container. If 'other', the container should be empty/hidden.

Step 4: For the MORNING card, create a styled card (using existing bg-[#f2ebe1] pattern or similar warm tone) containing: greeting 'Good Morning' with sun emoji, bullet list of tips (walk 2-5 mins, wash face, drink water), prompt text 'Ready to continue with a Morning Reset?', and three buttons: 'Quick Routine', 'Full Routine', 'Customize'. Include a dismiss X button in the top-right corner.

Step 5: For the NIGHT card, create a styled card (dark/calming tones like bg-[#2a3345] or similar) containing: header 'Preparing for sleep?' with moon emoji, then 4 sub-cards displayed vertically: Card 1 'Do your duties', Card 2 'Oil your hair', Card 3 pen/notebook journaling card (with the exact text from the spec about writing thoughts, worries, ideas and noting 3 important things for tomorrow), Card 4 'Drink a glass of milk'. Final prompt about beginning Yog Nidra practice. Two buttons: 'Start Yog Nidra', 'Customize'. Include a dismiss X button.

Step 6: Add dismiss functionality - when user clicks the X button, hide the suggestion card for the current session (use a flag in appState like 'suggestionDismissed'). The card should reappear on next page load/session.

Step 7: Call renderSmartSuggestion() inside the window.onload function (after existing initialization) and also whenever switchTab('reset') is called to ensure the card appears when returning to home.
Step 8: Ensure the existing feeling selection buttons (overthinking, decision fatigue, etc.) remain fully functional and visible below the suggestion card. No changes to the timer architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Morning suggestion card appears when browser time is between 05:00-09:59 AM
Night suggestion card appears when browser time is between 08:00 PM-02:00 AM (hours 20-23 and 0-1)
No suggestion card appears at other times
Morning card displays exact content specified: greeting, 3 bullet tips, 3 buttons (Quick Routine, Full Routine, Customize)
Night card displays exact content: 4 numbered pre-sleep step cards with specified text, 2 buttons (Start Yog Nidra, Customize)
Cards can be dismissed with an X button, dismissed state persists for current session only
Existing feeling selection (overthinking, decision fatigue, etc.) remains fully functional below the card
No changes to the timer architecture or practice engine
Card styling follows existing design system (Tailwind classes, sage/sand colors, rounded cards)
verification: Open index.html in browser and verify the suggestion card renders (may need to temporarily set time for testing)
Verify dismiss button hides the card
Verify clicking feeling selection buttons still navigates to recommendations view
Check that the JavaScript has no console errors by opening browser dev tools
